headline: The Air Force investigated 12,618 UFO sightings. 701 were never explained.
slides: The US Air Force launched Project Blue Book, based at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio.
That is how many sightings were reported to the Air Force between 1947 and 1969.
The peak year was 1952: 1,501 reports, and 303 of them could not be identified.
In total, 701 sightings stayed marked UNIDENTIFIED when the files were closed.
Project Bluebook image of Simonton home Eagle River Wisconsin 1.jpg
The Air Force shut the project down.
?Robert Seamans Secretary of the Air Force
Its conclusion: no sighting was a threat, and there was no evidence the unidentified ones were extraterrestrial.
sources: Sources: USAF Fact Sheet 95-03, US National Archives (Project BLUE BOOK records)
